name: Sun Cleric: Dawnfall's aura tooltip states its 15% values instead of 0% (#9781)
contract: Dawnfall 806118 is three persistent area auras: effect 1 MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER and effect 2 the Solar Flare
trigger reach enemies, effect 3 MOD_HEALING_PCT reaches allies (BasePoints 14 resolves to 15 for both percentages).
Its client tooltip reads both live amounts ${$w1} and ${$w3}, but each unit carries only one half, so
SMSG_ASCENSION_AURA_AMOUNT sends 0 for the other and the text reads 'take 0% increased'. Its damage line used
Dawnfall's own empty effect 2 amount with an SP*0.12 term, while the struck Solar Flare 807175 deals
$807175m2+$807175ppl2 plus 0.26 spell power (its own description and the Sun Cleric coefficient table).
The tooltip is streamed through coa_client_spell_description with the static $s1/$s3 values and Solar Flare's
formula, and the native description is kept. Rendered client text is outside the harness.

steps.label: The existing description stream is captured
Enemies see the static damage-taken value
steps.text: Enemies inside take $s1% increased damage from the Sun Cleric

steps.label: Allies see the static healing value
steps.text: Allies inside take $s3% increased healing from all sources.

steps.label: The damage line uses Solar Flare's formula
The native description is kept
steps.text: Bring down the light of An'she down at the target location for $d.
